references.text: The story that the older generation was to die in the wilderness because of their unbelief, explaining why the children had to be circumcised instead of the parents.
Confirmation that the entire old generation died in the wilderness, except for Caleb and Joshua, and that the new generation took their place.
Moses' prophecy that the children who did not know good and evil would inherit the land, which is fulfilled here when Joshua circumcises them.
Description of how God let the entire fighting force die out in the wilderness over forty years until the new generation was ready.
The original covenant of circumcision that God gave to Abraham, now being fulfilled for the new generation before they enter the Promised Land.
The immediate context where God commands Joshua to circumcise the Israelites, which this verse explains the background for.
